paper.title_en: CoS++: Towards More General and Explicit Implementations for Sampling High-Order Feynman Diagrammatic Series
paper.abstract_en: We extend combinatorial summation (CoS) of connected Feynman diagrams to Hubbard mod- els with flavor-dependent propagators and counterterm shifts. The construction combines an interaction-occupancy mask with labels for the open fermion cycle, allowing equivalent endpoint his- tories to be accumulated while retaining the flavor and sublattice information needed by subsequent contractions. In the flavor-dependent version, denoted symmetry-broken CoS (SB-CoS), normal heads carry the cycle flavor and counterterm heads inherit the flavor at their interaction partner. We prove the correctness of the resulting recurrence and introduce terminal readouts that return all nonempty interaction-subset values from a shared circuit, as required by a many-configuration Markov-chain sampler. For three flavors, a second formulation uses determinant polynomials and a local interaction tensor, with connected coefficients extracted by subset recursion or Fourier interpo- lation and a support sieve. Applications to the two-spin honeycomb and three-flavor square-lattice Hubbard models illustrate the treatment of sublattice structure and non-uniform reference shifts.
